overall_assessment: All 10 courses were reviewed in full as presented in the packet; learning-outcome groups are intact and final assessment is generally separated from compulsory activities. All four suspects have false-positive pre-pass flags: PPXP100 is a real prerequisite, the long reading section is legitimate, and the apparent reading-list leak describes teaching support. Unflagged defects include AI rules omitted in all 10 courses (including all six controls), seven reading-list placeholders, misfiled teaching/assessment content, and occasional administrative contamination; packet truncation markers are not treated as extraction defects.

findings.evidence: K1 - det gis ikke anledning til å bruke KI i forbindelse med eksamen.
findings.description: Every course has substantive AI-use rules under Om bruk av KI that are absent from assessment, although course_plan_spec.md explicitly includes these rules in assessment design. The same lost block also contains teaching/content statements in PPFD201 and PPXP100, such as AI being used in ordinary teaching. This is partial loss of existing sections, not absence of an entire assessment section.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R has no mapping for Om bruk av KI. NMBU reads it as a top-level heading; sectionize() in R/extract_sections.R closes the preceding section and drops text beneath an unmapped heading.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an exact mapping for Om bruk av KI to assessment. Within NMBU AI blocks, route the explicit sentences about KI forming part of course content or ordinary teaching to course_content or teaching_methods, while retaining permissions, prohibitions and disclosure requirements in assessment.

findings.description: Seven courses emit reading_list rows containing only a promise of later publication or a pointer to Canvas, with no literature or substantive syllabus description. Under course_plan_spec.md a section whose only text says it is elsewhere is not emitted. PPFO301 and PPRA301 instead contain substantive literature descriptions and should be retained.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The whole-row placeholder matcher (.placeholder_phrases / .is_placeholder_text in R/extract_sections.R) covers some publication and platform pointers but misses these NMBU formulations.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the anchored whole-row reading-list placeholder patterns to cover Kunngjøres i Canvas, Blir opplyst på Canvas ved oppstart, Oversikt ... Canvas, and Emnets litteratur vil foreligge ved oppstart av emnet. Keep rows containing substantive literature descriptions in addition to a platform pointer.

findings.evidence: Masteroppgaven kan leveres skriftlig eller i multimodal form og utføres individuelt eller i samarbeid mellom to eller tre studenter.
findings.description: Om dette emnet is copied wholesale to course_content even where the text describes teaching arrangements or assessment design. M30-LUN puts thesis format, individual/group submission and documentation of each student contribution there, together with supervision arrangements; the individual/group design is missing from assessment. PPRA201 and PPRA301 likewise put extensive placement organisation, duration and supervision text into course_content rather than teaching_methods. These passages describe how students work or are assessed rather than subject matter.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The heading-based sectionize() assignment maps all prose beneath Om dette emnet to course_content and does not redistribute mixed-purpose sentences by the codebook definitions.
findings.suggested_fix: Add narrowly scoped NMBU sentence routing after sectionization: move thesis submission-format and individual/group-contribution sentences to assessment, and placement-duration, organisation and supervision sentences to teaching_methods. Preserve genuine subject-matter prose and avoid duplicating sentences already present in the destination.

findings.evidence: Emnet er obligatorisk for studenter tatt opp til studieprogrammet LUR.
findings.description: Two prerequisites rows retain a separate sentence about the course being compulsory for students admitted to a programme; PPFD301 also includes its semester placement. These statements are programme administration, not required prior knowledge. The following sentences name genuine prior courses and must remain.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R applies .strip_admission_lines(), but the wording Emnet er obligatorisk for studenter tatt opp til ... is not recognised as administrative prerequisite noise.
findings.suggested_fix: Strip the complete standalone sentence beginning Emnet er obligatorisk for studenter tatt opp til from NMBU prerequisites, including the semester-placement clause where present. Preserve the subsequent subject-matter requirements and sentences that combine admission with genuine academic requirements.

findings.evidence: Dersom studenten ikke består en praksisperiode, kan samme periode gjennomføres bare en gang til.
findings.description: Although Sensorordning is correctly dropped, examiner/responsibility arrangements embedded under the main assessment heading survive in PPRA201 and PPRA301. PPRA301 additionally retains the quoted repeat-attempt rule and an ongoing suitability-review notice. These are arrangements or notices about assessment rather than the assessment design specified by the rubric.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The .drop heading rule only removes the separate Sensorordning block; .strip_section_noise() does not cover these NMBU sentences inside an otherwise substantive assessment block.
findings.suggested_fix: Add NMBU-specific sentence filters for the quoted repeat-attempt rule, the standalone continuous skikkethetsvurdering notice, and the standalone sentence allocating assessment responsibility between practice school and NMBU. Retain pass/fail scales, assessed practice components and the condition that each practice period must pass.

findings.evidence: LUR/Profesjonsmaster PPU, profil realfag: Oversikt over samlingene vil bli lagt fram i juni 2025
findings.description: The teaching_methods section includes a notice announcing when the gathering schedule will be published. This administrative publication notice describes no teaching or learning method. The adjacent description of four physical gatherings is substantive and belongs in teaching_methods.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Undervisningstider maps to teaching_methods; the cleanup retains both substantive gathering descriptions and this schedule-publication notice.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove NMBU sentences matching Oversikt over samlingene vil bli lagt fram ... from teaching_methods, preserving profile labels where needed for remaining content and retaining actual teaching formats and gathering durations.
